name: Hirokawa (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Hirokawa town emblem in blue: a stylised angular device with a ring, like a bird.
history: Municipal flag of Hirokawa, a town in Fukuoka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 December 1965.

features.role: Hirokawa town emblem — a stylised angular device with a ring, like a bird
